highlights: Panel replies land in the right terminal tab far more reliably — and never vanish silently when they can't

changes.text: Each session's terminal tab is now tagged with a hidden marker while ClaudeBell can reliably identify it, so a later reply targets that exact tab directly — no more cycling through tabs or mis-pasting when several sessions share a folder, a tab was reopened, or macOS recycled the terminal's device number. On iTerm2 the tab is matched by its stable session id, so nothing is written to the title.

A panel reply that can't reach the session's terminal tab is no longer lost silently: your text stays in the field, it's copied to the clipboard, and an inline warning tells you to switch to that session and paste it. Previously the panel closed with no error and the text was dropped.

highlights: Reply to Claude straight from the panel — delivered through the Stop hook, with reliable terminal-tab targeting as the fallback

changes.text: Direct reply: when you answer shortly after Claude finishes a turn (while you're not at the terminal), your reply — a Send or a question option — is delivered to Claude directly through the Stop hook, with no keystrokes typed into the terminal. A countdown badge shows how long the direct channel stays open.
New 'Direct Reply' setting to choose how long the direct channel stays open after a turn (5 minutes, 30 minutes, 4 hours, or 24 hours).
'Create new session' now opens a new tab in your existing terminal window instead of spawning a separate window (when a window is already open).

Panel replies that fall back to the terminal now land in the exact tab — even after restarting ClaudeBell and with several sessions in the same folder. ClaudeBell remembers each session's terminal across launches, validates it, and routes to the owning terminal app (Terminal.app, iTerm2, Warp). No more cycling through tabs or pasting into the wrong one.
Notifications now clear right away when you reply in the terminal, instead of lingering until they time out.
A question card (AskUserQuestion) you already answered in the terminal no longer gets stuck in the panel.
Notifications you've already answered no longer reappear.
Pressing the 'open in terminal' button now closes the ClaudeBell panel and takes you to the console.

highlights: More reliable message sending into Terminal.app

changes.text: Sending a reply or follow-up into Terminal.app no longer occasionally leaves the text sitting in Claude's input without submitting. ClaudeBell now pastes the message and sends the Return as a separate keystroke — the way you would by hand — so it submits every time. Note: this uses a system keystroke, so ClaudeBell needs Accessibility permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility); re-add ClaudeBell there if sending stops working after updating.

highlights: Opening the terminal from the Sessions list now closes the panel

changes.text: Clicking "Open in Terminal" next to a session in the Sessions list now dismisses the ClaudeBell panel after bringing the matching terminal tab to the front — matching the behaviour of the same button inside notifications

highlights: Jump to the terminal straight from any session in the list

changes.text: Every session in the Sessions list now has its own "Open in Terminal" button, right next to the rename and dismiss controls — click it to bring the matching terminal tab to the front without waiting for a notification

highlights: Restore AskUserQuestion answers — Claude Code 2.1.150+ compatibility

changes.text: AskUserQuestion answers now reach Claude Code again on recent Claude Code versions (2.1.150 and later). The CLI dropped its in-terminal TUI picker for these tool calls, which left every answer empty — the panel selections never made it back. ClaudeBell now returns the selected option labels (and any custom text) directly in the permission hook response, so Claude receives a fully populated answer the moment you submit.

highlights: Open a new Claude session in any directory, right from the panel

changes.text: Brand new "New Session" launcher: pick a directory and (optionally) a session name and an initial prompt — ClaudeBell opens a new tab in your terminal, runs `claude`, and tracks the session under the name you gave it
A prominent "+ New Session" bar now lives just above the Sessions panel, both in the empty state and the sidebar — always one click away
Recent Projects are remembered automatically: pick one from the form's Recent tab, or right-click the menu bar icon and use the "Recent Projects ▸" submenu to jump straight back in
Session name set at launch shows up in the sidebar and the menu, so multiple projects are easier to tell apart at a glance
Recent and Browse are now mutually exclusive choices in the launcher form so the source of the directory is always unambiguous
"Open in Terminal" moved out of the footer and into a compact ghost-style button right next to the notification title — closer to where the eye already is, no extra footer chrome
Inline code blocks in notification text use a larger, easier-to-read font size
